guidelineVersion: TCCC Guidelines (CoTCCC), 25 January 2024; card layout after the TCCC casualty card and MIST-AT report in lesson 1022, Taking a History and Casualty Card (26 June 2017)

fields.name: trainingId
fields.label: Training ID
fields.helper: Training identity only, for example LANE 3 / MANIKIN B. Never a name, a service number or a date of birth.

fields.name: casualtyNumber
fields.label: Casualty number
fields.helper: Position in the casualty count on the lane, for example 2 of 4.

fields.name: timeOfWounding
fields.label: Time of wounding
fields.helper: Scenario clock time the injury happened.

fields.name: arrivalTime
fields.label: Responder arrival time
fields.helper: Scenario clock time you reached the casualty.

fields.name: sex
fields.label: Sex
fields.helper: From the training scenario, not a real person.

fields.name: age
fields.label: Age
fields.helper: From the training scenario. Leave empty if the lane does not set one.

fields.name: triageCategory
fields.label: Triage category
fields.helper: The card prints five triage colours; use the colour-to-category mapping your course teaches.

fields.name: mechanism
fields.label: Mechanism of injury
fields.helper: Tick every mechanism that applies. GSW is a gunshot wound, MVA a motor vehicle accident.

fields.name: mechanismOther
fields.label: Other mechanism
fields.helper: Fill in only when Other is ticked above.

fields.name: injurySites
fields.label: Injury sites
fields.helper: Name the limb and the side for each injury. The paper card marks these on a body diagram.

fields.name: burnTbsa
fields.label: Burned body surface (%)
fields.helper: Estimate to the nearest 10 percent with the Rule of Nines.

fields.name: avpu
fields.label: Level of consciousness (AVPU)
fields.helper: First estimate, recorded before any analgesia.

fields.name: gcsScore
fields.label: GCS score
fields.helper: Glasgow Coma Scale total, 3 to 15, if your course records one.

fields.name: pupilsEqualReactive
fields.label: Pupils equal and reactive
fields.helper: Untick and describe in the notes when the pupils differ or do not react.

fields.name: signsSymptoms
fields.label: S - signs and symptoms
fields.helper: What the casualty shows and reports.

fields.name: medications
fields.label: M - medications
fields.helper: What the casualty already takes.

fields.name: pastHistory
fields.label: P - past medical history
fields.helper: Earlier injuries, surgery and illnesses.

fields.name: lastMeal
fields.label: L - last meal, in and out

fields.name: events
fields.label: E - events leading to the injury

fields.name: vitals
fields.label: Vital signs
fields.helper: One row per set of observations. The paper card has room for three.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: T
fields.helper: Temperature.

fields.name: pulse
fields.label: P
fields.helper: Pulse per minute.

fields.name: respiratoryRate
fields.label: R
fields.helper: Breaths per minute.

fields.name: bloodPressure
fields.label: BP
fields.helper: For example 110/70.

fields.name: capillaryRefill
fields.label: CRT
fields.helper: Capillary refill time in seconds.

fields.name: spo2
fields.label: SpO2 (%)
fields.helper: Oxygen saturation by pulse oximetry.

fields.name: tourniquets
fields.label: Tourniquets applied
fields.helper: One row per tourniquet. The same time goes in marker on the strap itself.

fields.name: timeReapplied
fields.label: Time reapplied
fields.helper: When a hasty tourniquet was converted onto bare skin.

fields.name: vascularAccess
fields.label: IV or IO access
fields.helper: Site and gauge, for example 18 G left antecubital.

fields.name: fluids
fields.label: Fluids given
fields.helper: Type, volume and time, for example LR 500 ml at 14:40.

fields.name: drugs
fields.label: Drugs given
fields.helper: One row per drug. The paper card groups them as TXA, antibiotic, pain meds and others.

fields.name: route
fields.label: Route
fields.helper: PO by mouth, IV intravenous, IO intraosseous, IM intramuscular, IN intranasal.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.helper: Anything the boxes above do not hold, including changes in the casualty's status.

fields.name: responder
fields.label: Responder call sign
fields.helper: Call sign or student number. No real names on a training card.

fields.name: lane
fields.label: Lane or location
fields.helper: Where the training serial ran.
